firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the first turn. Play then proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: During standard setup, the youngest player also begins placing caste pieces in cities. Village placement continues with the next player after the final city placement.
The optional Basic Setup for first-time players randomizes starting hands and caste placement. Regular play still follows the printed youngest-player start.
